name: io.github.zima-explorer/wechat-to-kb
title: wechat-to-kb
description: Read URL content or save a single WeChat article, web page, or video URL to a local knowledge base with auto-routing and optional AI-powered categorization. The MCP surface is intentionally small for daily assistant use.

environmentVariables.name: KB_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Root directory of the local knowledge base (default: ~/knowledge_base)

environmentVariables.name: KB_NON_INTERACTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to disable interactive routing prompts (required in MCP context)

environmentVariables.name: KB_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to run Playwright browser in headless mode (recommended for server/background use)

environmentVariables.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Recommended: DeepSeek API key for LLM-powered sub-category routing and enrichment (KB_ROUTE_LLM=1). Cost-effective alternative to Anthropic.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Alternative to DEEPSEEK_API_KEY for LLM features. Used if DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is not set.

environmentVariables.name: KB_ROUTE_LLM
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to enable LLM-powered sub-category routing. Significantly improves accuracy over keyword matching. Requires DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: KB_ROUTE_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model to use for sub-category routing (default: deepseek-chat). Use claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 if using Anthropic.
